The creature reaches the area referred to as the central brain.

Its impact reactivates an attack program, shown with explosive sound effects and flashing machinery.
A system call brings the three proto-nuclear units online or summons them, revealed in the final large panel.

visual_summary: A small insect-like mechanical organism flies through a vast bright technological interior, reaches a chamber identified by narration as the central brain, crashes itself into a dense wall of controls, triggers a violent attack routine, and the page ends on a large industrial cavity containing heavy machinery identified as three proto-nuclear units.
